card.meaningEn: To change gradually from one form or character into another.
card.howUsed: Originally from computer graphics animation, now widely used when things, people or ideas gradually transform into something else.
examples: Over the years, the casual meetup morphed into a full-scale tech conference.
The small startup morphed into a major enterprise software provider.
In the animated video, the caterpillar slowly morphed into a butterfly.
What started as a friendly debate morphed into a heated argument.
